data.one_liner: Displays a square-shaped progress indicator with a percentage label.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single widget that draws a square progress bar and shows the current percent value inside. The widget is fully customizable (size, colors, border radius, shadow, etc.) and supports null‑safety.
use_when: You need a simple square progress indicator in a Flutter UI.
You want easy customization of colors, size, and border radius without writing custom paint code.
avoid_when: You require animated progress changes or complex charting features.
You need circular, linear, or gauge‑style indicators instead of a square shape.
strengths: Very easy to use with a single widget call

alternatives.name: percent_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers both circular and linear progress indicators with more features and animation support.

data.minimal_example:
SquarePercentIndicator(
  width:140,
  height:140,
  startAngle:StartAngle.bottomRight,
  reverse:true,
  borderRadius:12,
  shadowWidth:1.5,
  progressWidth:5,
  shadowColor:Colors.grey,
  progressColor:Colors.blue,
  progress:0.54,
  child:Center(child:Text('54 %',style:TextStyle(fontWeight:FontWeight.bold,fontSize:20))),
);
